# Ryall's Auto Detailing Centre (RADC)

> Car detailing centre in Oudtshoorn, Western Cape, South Africa. Ceramic coating, 1- to 3-step paint correction, full valets, washes, headlight restoration, dent, scratch and rim repair and resprays. Serves Oudtshoorn, the Klein Karoo, the Garden Route (George, Mossel Bay, Knysna, Plettenberg Bay) and the Central Karoo (Prince Albert, Beaufort West).

## Key facts
- Name: Ryall's Auto Detailing Centre (RADC)
- Slogan: Cleaner | Shinier | Protected
- Address: 27 Heunis Street, Colridge View, Oudtshoorn, 6620, Western Cape, South Africa
- Phone & WhatsApp: 081 087 6539 (+27810876539)
- Email: rwagenaar398@gmail.com
- Owner: Ryall Wagenaar
- Google rating: 5.0 stars (13 reviews)
- Hours: Mon–Sat 8am–5pm · Sunday closed
- Bookings: via WhatsApp

## Services
- [Ceramic Coating](https://www.radc.co.za/services/ceramic-coating/): 12-month-plus and 5-year ceramic packages, paired with 1-, 2- or 3-step polishing for a slick, protected finish.
- [Paint Correction & Polishing](https://www.radc.co.za/services/paint-correction-polishing/): 1-step, 2-step and 3-step machine polishing to remove swirls, oxidation and dullness and bring back deep gloss.
- [Valets & Washes](https://www.radc.co.za/services/car-valet-wash/): From a quick wash & vacuum to a full valet, decon wash, clay bar and engine-bay detail.
- [Headlight Restoration](https://www.radc.co.za/services/headlight-restoration/): Yellow, cloudy headlights sanded, polished and protected — safer night driving and a fresher-looking car.
- [Dents, Scratches & Resprays](https://www.radc.co.za/services/dent-scratch-repair/): Scratch and faded-paint removal, minor dent repairs, rim repairs, bumper alignment and full resprays.

## Areas served
- [Oudtshoorn](https://www.radc.co.za/): home base
- [George](https://www.radc.co.za/areas/george/): George, Blanco, Wilderness, Pacaltsdorp, Herold's Bay (about 55 km from Oudtshoorn)
- [Mossel Bay](https://www.radc.co.za/areas/mossel-bay/): Mossel Bay, Hartenbos, Great Brak River, KwaNonqaba, Dana Bay (about 85 km from Oudtshoorn)
- [Knysna & Plettenberg Bay](https://www.radc.co.za/areas/knysna-plettenberg-bay/): Knysna, Sedgefield, Plettenberg Bay, Brenton-on-Sea, Keurboomstrand (about 120–150 km from Oudtshoorn)
- [The Klein Karoo](https://www.radc.co.za/areas/klein-karoo/): De Rust, Dysselsdorp, Calitzdorp, Ladismith, Uniondale, Van Wyksdorp (25–100 km from Oudtshoorn)
- [The Central Karoo](https://www.radc.co.za/areas/central-karoo/): Prince Albert, Beaufort West, Laingsburg, Klaarstroom, Leeu-Gamka (about 75–230 km from Oudtshoorn)
